name: founder-ide-extension
description: Registers the Founder OS AI Gateway as a first-class VS Code chat model provider. Streams tokens from your own routing layer into the built-in Chat view. Works in Cursor, VSCodium, stock VS Code, and Windsurf.

chatParticipants.name: Founder OS
chatParticipants.description: Chat with the Founder OS AI Gateway (routed via your node)

commands.title: Founder OS: Pair with Founder Node

founderOs.apiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Optional override for the Founder OS API base URL. If empty, the extension reads `apiBaseUrl` from `~/FounderVault/node-config.json`.

founderOs.nodeId.markdownDescription: Optional override for the Founder Node ID. If empty, the extension reads `nodeId` from `~/FounderVault/node-config.json`.

founderOs.nodeToken.markdownDescription: Optional override for the Founder Node token. If empty, the extension reads `nodeToken` from `~/FounderVault/node-config.json`.

founderOs.requestTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for gateway calls (including streaming).
